<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 49

**Prerequisites**
You speak [Muan](/Languages.aspx?ID=108).

</column>

---

Your connection to elemental wood allows you to communicate with trees in the [Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=1) in Muan, the language of wood elementals. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) skill with woody plants like trees and shrubs.
